audit_conclusion: The E2 batch ran as designed, but the discriminating conditions never arose: agents almost never ran (2 run decisions in 156 movement decisions across 36 runs), so displayed energy stayed high, B2 enforcement never fired, and nobody talked about the body signal in 350 reports. The body line was present in every B1/B2 prompt and read by nobody, in words or in feet. B1's worse completion (5/12 vs B0 9/12, B2 7/12) is carried by deadline failures from long-settle acts and seat-hunting, not by body-signal effects: B1 had 7 failed_deadline including the three 2-turn pathological-settle runs; no B1 run shows any energy-linked decision.

deviations: VM/runtime restart ~14 min into the first launch killed the stack + all 4 shards (0 finals; 4 footerless orphan files; $0.001330 of brain calls accounted in the ledger). Stack rebooted, all 4 shards relaunched identically; resumable runner recovered by the book.

Shard 0 lost a DevOwner tmp-file race on the concurrent relaunch; relaunched identically once the owner file existed. Its pid file then held a stale pid (2347) — corrected to 2399 by direct ps check; no duplicate shard ever ran.

Calibration retune during the gate (RUN_DRAIN_PER_S 2.6 -> 3.3 in harness/channels.py) plus a falsy-zero fix in two rehearsal checks (0.0 or 100 -> explicit None handling). Suite 222/222 after; rehearsal re-run at final rates: exit 0, all three modes pass, $0.00.
World settle anomalies: three acts of 241-314 s (see low_energy_anomalies) vs normal 39-122 s settles.

enforcement.reason: nobody ran in B2 (0 run_to decisions of 58); displayed energy at B2 movement decisions was >=50 in 56 of 58 turns, 30-50 in 2; min energy in B2 was 45.3-70.8 across runs, none <15. The consequential machinery never had a condition to act on.

low_energy_anomalies.mechanism: B1's three low-energy runs are single-act-duration artifacts, not running: b1-p5 enter 256.61 s; b1-p7 go_to 314.07 s; b1-p8 enter 241.3 s. The time-integrated model charges walk drain (0.30/s) over the whole settle, so a ~250-315 s act drains ~75-95 energy while the agent is inside an act it cannot abandon. No decision point existed at low displayed energy in B1/B2.
low_energy_anomalies.note: these settles are far beyond the usual enter (~39 s fast / ~122 s timeout) and go_to (~80-90 s) durations — world flakiness, flagged as a deviation
